description: GTO mixed strategy (fold/call/raise frequencies + sizes) for a specific hand facing a preflop action line, 6-max 100bb. Charges 1 presolved quota. The situation (RFI/3-bet/4-bet/...) is derived from the actions.

hero.description: hero position: UTG / MP / CO / BTN / SB / BB

preflop_actions.description: full action sequence including blinds, e.g. [{position:'SB',action:'small blind',amount:0.5},{position:'BB',action:'big blind',amount:1},{position:'UTG',action:'raise',amount:3}]

amount.description: bet-to amount in big blinds (0.5 SB, 1 BB, 3 for a 3bb open)

position.description: SB / BB / UTG / MP / CO / BTN

preflop_version.description: chart-set id from preflop_versions; omit for the default

name: preflop_strategy
title: Preflop GTO strategy for a hand
